name: reasonable-agents
description: Harness-enforced adversarial review for Claude Code subagents. After an *-expert subagent runs, H4 injects a directive to run its paired *-reviewer, and H6 validates the reviewer's output against a structural schema, so the review isn't a file you hope the agent reads. Hooks fail open; compliance is model-mediated, not mechanical (see CLAIMS.md).
